_families.name: Bongo Rx Annual Replenishment Pack
_families.description: Bongo Rx – Annual Replenishment Pack. Each pack includes 4 Bongo Rx devices of a single size, a headgear, a travel case and a drying stand. Choose the size (XS, SM, MD, LG or XL); each size is its own AirAvant part number (BNG501–BNG505). AirAvant: once a patient knows their preferred size and has used the Starter Kit for up to 90 days, order the Annual Replenishment Pack in that size. Sizes can be mixed and matched for quantity pricing. XS is offered in replenishment packs and single units only — the Starter Kit holds SM, MD, LG and XL.

_families.name: Bongo Rx Single Replenishment Unit
_families.description: Bongo Rx – Single Replenishment Unit. Each unit includes 1 Bongo Rx device of a single size and a headgear only (no travel case or drying stand). Choose the size (XS, SM, MD, LG or XL); each size is its own AirAvant part number (BNG511–BNG515). Sizes can be mixed and matched for quantity pricing.
